items.text: vocabulary.stagedIntents section in app-manifest (mirrors contentTypes): per-entry description/intentSchema $ref/graduatesTo/actionableFrom[SessionLifecycleState]/resolutionMode/three-leg coupling

Three-leg coupling discipline on staged intents: knowledge leg (EPR relationship types graduated entry participates in), value leg (onGraduate REA action), governance leg (canonical-entry reach + signal types)

stagedIntents validation: required fields, intentSchema $ref resolves, actionableFrom validates against SessionLifecycleState enum, resolutionMode one-of-three, coupling validates against contentTypes three-leg sub-schema; does NOT verify graduatesTo entry exists

graduation top-level section: deterministicCeremony (required when section exists), negotiatedCeremony, framingCid (per-pillar elohim-role declaration), appraisalAgent (home/commons/neutral/custom), notarizeAppraisal (always/on-request/never)
SessionLifecycleState enum (Anonymous/OauthIdentified/PeerNativeSampling/PeerNativeMember) at sdk/schemas/v1/enums; generated artifacts; relationship to Capability Profile protocol-core Standings

app-manifest.schema.json updates: vocabulary.stagedIntents (sibling to contentTypes) + top-level graduation (sibling to rendering/gates) + new $defs + conditional validation + backward compat (both optional)
Per-pillar codegen extension: each scripts/codegen.mjs emits staged-intents.ts + graduation-policy.ts; distribution; empty-section behavior
Protocol-level codegen integration: new INTERFACE_FILES entries + SessionLifecycleState enum + schema-contract test
Per-pillar manifest examples: lamad (staged-mastery-intent), imagodei, qahal, shefa, mishpat (no staged intents), hypothetical third-party tikvah
Relationship to runtime CeremonyRegistry: ceremony strings are registry lookup keys; bridge composes deterministic-then-negotiated per resolutionMode

Open design questions: coupling required on staged intents; ceremony ID namespacing convention; per-staged-intent consent-required flag; third-party pillar manifest authorization; cross-pillar staged intents; resolutionMode either semantics
